r5_verdict.shape_enumeration: complete for the str|None + missing-key input domain; no fourth in-domain shape exists. codex narrowed the guard to reject only None and "" and still got 31 passed, so the suite does NOT pin 0/False/[]/{} individually -- those are type errors, and demanding general type validation has no basis in the frozen scope. Whitespace-only, untrimmed and scheme-less URLs are accepted by design: this guard owns the missing-value check, and making it do strip/scheme/URL validation would add a new responsibility, so it is explicitly not grounds for rejection.
r5_verdict.fixture_self_check: effective but bounded. Flipping the fixture to None yields 1 failed, so it does close the hole it claims. It does NOT protect the whole matrix: repointing the declared_empty entry at the None fixture still gives 31 passed, and deleting the entry gives 29 passed. Not theatre, not a completeness proof; the wiring at this commit is correct, and these are future-edit risks that do not block the ACCEPT.
